display_information.name: Gable
display_information.description: Turns listing form submissions into ready-to-polish social posts.
display_information.long_description: Gable watches the listing intake sheet, resolves a photo for each property, verifies the submitting agent contact details against their brokerage site, matches the agent to their template, and assembles a finished post ready for review. It reports what it found and what it could not find, flags anything uncertain, and never marks a post ready while a required field is empty.

slash_commands.description: Check status, force a run, retry a listing, or list templates
slash_commands.usage_hint: status | run | retry <run_id> | templates | pause | resume
